description: Asks the public ChatGPT, Google AI Mode and Gemini apps 18 shopping questions written from a Shopify store’s catalogue in its market’s language, plus what the store is known for and, on ChatGPT, its returns and free shipping. Reports an AI visibility score; how often each assistant names the store, cites its pages or shows its products, by product line; who the answers name most often and which sources they cite; how AI describes the store; and whether ChatGPT states its return window and free-shipping threshold correctly. Real app answers, signed out, not model APIs. Free, no sign-in; waits up to 45 seconds, the first answers arrive within a minute and the rest within about 5. Shared per store for a day; unmeasured items are reported as unknown.

country.description: The market to check, as a two-letter ISO country code such as GB. Omit it for the store’s main market.

domain.description: The Shopify storefront to check, e.g. example.com. Required until a store is connected; afterwards, omit it to use a connected store.

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.

name: check_ai_visibility
title: AI visibility check
